polymer.basis: A clear, styrene-rich styrene-butadiene block copolymer whose glassy polystyrene phase carries the load: a stiff amorphous styrenic, not an elastomer (the owner's rulings, 2026-10-20, R231, D176). INEOS Styrolution's sheet for Styrolux 656C (R-INEOS-STYROLUX-656C-TDS) calls it "a clear styrene-butadiene copolymer (SBC)" and a "Tough and stiff grade", and prints a tensile modulus of 1800 MPa (ISO 527), a Shore D hardness of 72 (ISO 868), an HDT B of 77 °C (ISO 75) and a density of 1020 kg/m³ (ISO 1183); its K-Resin KR03 page (R-INEOS-KRESIN-KR03-PAGE, the Wayback Machine's capture of 2021-11-04) prints Shore D 63 and a density of 1.01 g/cm³ (ASTM D 792), the figures FormFutura's Crystal Flex (M174) prints. The density range is those two references' figures. An elastomeric SBC (INEOS's Styroflex, Shore 86A, 70 MPa) is a TPS (M170), not this row.
